full_judgment: 5. The learned counsel appearing for the respondent No.1 on the other handed submits that the Government, the appellant herein, did never serve any notice either upon the respondent No.1 or upon the original owner of the building for surrendering their possession declaring the building as abandoned properly and there was also no material before the Court of Settlement to show that the possession of the building has been taken over by the appellant at any time in compliance of section 5(1) of the Ordinance No. 54 of 1985 or P.O. No. 16 of 1972 and further the respondent No.1 along with his vendor, was also in physical possession of the building and was never dispossessed from the building and stilt is in possession of the same on mutating his name in the Government Khatian and has been paying municipal taxes, gas bills and so the decision of the High Court Division does not call for any interference
